description: Build and quality pipeline for the starsync CLI. Provides bun build for bundled output, bun build --compile for standalone binary, and smoke:qc combining typecheck (tsc --noEmit), lint (eslint), and format check (prettier). Also includes format, lint:fix, and individual typecheck/lint commands.
notes: Backfilled by feature-coverage-audit from current implementation evidence on 2026-06-10.
spec:
1. Verify `bun run build` produces a bundled output in dist/ from src/cli.ts.
2. Verify `bun run compile` produces a standalone binary at dist/starsync.
3. Verify `bun run smoke:qc` runs typecheck, lint, and format:check in sequence and passes.
4. Verify `bun run typecheck` passes with strict TypeScript settings.
5. Verify `bun run lint` passes with no errors.
6. Verify .prettierrc plugins and package.json devDependencies contain no prettier-plugin-tailwindcss — this CLI tool has no CSS/HTML/JSX or Tailwind usage; do NOT add frontend-oriented Prettier plugins.
title: Build and Compile Pipeline
